Your TXT 4.0 Controller needs a firmware update
Please follow the instructions step by step. If you have any questions, please contact <x id="INTERPOLATION" equiv-text="{{ 0 }}"/>.
CAUTION: DO NOT interrupt the power supply during the update process, otherwise the TXT 4.0 controller could be damaged.
Current version of the TXT 4.0 controller

The current version of the TXT 4.0 controller can be found on the controller in the menu:<x id="LINE_BREAK" ctype="lb" equiv-text="<br />"/><x id="LINE_BREAK" ctype="lb" equiv-text="<br />"/>Info -> Software Version
How would you like to update the controller?
When updating via Internet / WLAN, you do not need any external hardware, but the controller must be connected to the Internet.
When updating via USB stick or µSD card, you need the stick or card and a computer to prepare the stick or card.

Connect the TXT 4.0 Controller to an Internet router via WLAN. If an Internet connection has been set up, a globe symbol should be displayed in the status bar of the controller instead of the WLAN symbol. An update symbol is visible during an update, see image below:

Navigate to the menu: Settings -> Updates<x id="LINE_BREAK" ctype="lb" equiv-text="<br />"/><x id="LINE_BREAK" ctype="lb" equiv-text="<br />"/>Select the version under "Online updates". Press "Install". Updating the firmware via the Internet takes about 10-30 minutes. The duration depends on the Internet connection. For firmware version 3.1.0, you must first update to 3.1.4.
Update via USB stick or µSD card

Take a USB stick or a µSD card with a memory size of 4-32GB. These must be formatted as FAT32.<x id="LINE_BREAK" ctype="lb" equiv-text="<br />"/><x id="LINE_BREAK" ctype="lb" equiv-text="<br />"/>FAT32 should be displayed as the file system under Properties for the storage medium (under Windows, see image).<x id="LINE_BREAK" ctype="lb" equiv-text="<br />"/><x id="LINE_BREAK" ctype="lb" equiv-text="<br />"/>Download the update file, e.g. "imageqtbundleconv316.raucb" from the <x id="INTERPOLATION" equiv-text="{{ 0     }}"/><x id="LINE_BREAK" ctype="lb" equiv-text="<br />"/><x id="LINE_BREAK" ctype="lb" equiv-text="<br />"/>save this file to the storage medium. Then insert the storage medium into the TXT 4.0 controller.

Navigate to the menu: Settings -> Updates<x id="LINE_BREAK" ctype="lb" equiv-text="<br />"/><x id="LINE_BREAK" ctype="lb" equiv-text="<br />"/>Press "Open firmware file" and navigate to the update file.<x id="LINE_BREAK" ctype="lb" equiv-text="<br />"/><x id="LINE_BREAK" ctype="lb" equiv-text="<br />"/>ext_usb -> sda ... or ext_sd -> mmcblk1p1 ...<x id="LINE_BREAK" ctype="lb" equiv-text="<br />"/><x id="LINE_BREAK" ctype="lb" equiv-text="<br />"/>Press "Install". Updating the firmware takes about 10 minutes.

The update status should then be shown on the controller display. When the update is complete, a message will be displayed. If the process has been completed successfully, switch the TXT 4.0 Controller off and on again by pressing the ON/OFF button for >3 seconds at the end of the update. If the TXT 4.0 Controller has rebooted, a green tick symbol should be visible in the status bar at the end.
